description: This PHP source file defines the ExceptionSubscriber class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements Symfony's EventSubscriberInterface to handle exceptions during the HTTP request lifecycle, customizing responses based on exception type.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: Handles exception events in Symfony applications to generate appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the exception handling callback for the Kernel exception event.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Processes an exception event to set an appropriate HTTP response, particularly handling HttpExceptionInterface instances.
